name: In Practise
description:
In Practise runs primary research for fundamental investors. We interview the former operators and executives who ran the companies you're analysing, then turn those conversations into structured, cited research.

This connector brings that library into Claude. You can:

- Search thousands of expert interviews across public and private companies, sectors and business models
- Read full interviews and analysis, with verbatim quotes you can attribute to each source
- Look up companies and the moats behind them, assessed with the 7 Powers framework: scale economies, network effects, counter-positioning, switching costs, branding, cornered resource and process power
- Track the companies you care about with a personal watchlist

Ask Claude about a company, a competitor or an end market, and it pulls the relevant primary-source view from people who were actually in the room, rather than a summary scraped from the web.

Access requires an In Practise library subscription. Learn more at inpractise.com.

_published_faq.name: How do I add In Practise to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add In Practise to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://inpractise.com/api/v1/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the In Practise MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: In Practise provides these MCP tools: add_to_watchlist, get_articles_by_slug, get_core_data, remove_from_watchlist, search_articles, and search_companies.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to In Practise?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to In Practise in financial-services on the Manufact MCP catalog include Contract-Factory — Sociétés & SIREN, Kavara Kirk, CeylonCharts, Netzo, and Ramp Data.

_published_faq.name: Does In Practise MCP require authentication?

acceptedAnswer.text: In Practise requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
In Practise is developed by In Practise. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
